title: OWASP Juice Shop: Controlled Web-Security Training
summary: OWASP Juice Shop is a deliberately insecure web application for learning how flaws arise and how to fix them. It offers challenges at different difficulty levels, optional guided tutorials and coding exercises, with links to relevant mitigation guidance.
defensive_use: Use an isolated, explicitly authorized training copy to study application trust boundaries and remediation choices. Pair conceptual findings with the linked defensive guidance rather than treating challenge success as evidence about a real service.
prerequisites: A browser and basic HTTP/application concepts.
A suitable local training environment; the provider documents several installation options. No installation was performed.

access.note: The official overview identifies the application as free and open source under the MIT license. Self-hosting or third-party infrastructure can have separate costs; none were priced or provisioned.

published.note: Original publication date is not stated on the reviewed resource pages.

freshness.note: Official project, overview, learning, and release-news pages reviewed. The news page lists training application v20.2.0 released August 10, 2026; no runtime verification was performed.

caveats: This application is deliberately vulnerable. Keep exercises within an isolated training deployment you own or are explicitly authorized to use.
Tutorial availability and challenge counts vary by version. No public demo or local lab was tested.
